summary: std/http: a client refuses a Host with CR or LF (`http: invalid Host header`) and writes a User-Agent's CR and LF as spaces, as Go (GO-2023-1878)
details: a client refuses a Host with CR or LF (`http: invalid Host header`) and writes a User-Agent's CR and LF as spaces, as Go (GO-2023-1878). Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
